// @molis-ai/molis-work-plugin-sdk/subtask-conversation: public API snapshot.
// Generated by `node scripts/gates/api-snapshot.mjs --update`; do not edit by hand. A change below is a change to what plugins and other callers can use:
// say what it means for them in the PR.

export type SubtaskActionOutcome = {
    readonly state: "applied";
} | {
    readonly state: "not-applied";
    readonly reason: string;
} | {
    readonly state: "unknown";
    readonly check: () => Promise<SubtaskActionOutcome>;
};

export type SubtaskComposerOptions = Omit<Extract<ComposerOptions, {
    kind: "ai";
}>, "draft" | "placement" | "stop" | "pause"> & {
    readonly draft: {
        readonly adapter: ComposerDraftAdapter;
    };
};

export interface SubtaskConversationHandle {
    open(target: string): Promise<void>;
    refresh(): Promise<void>;
    close(): void;
    destroy(): void;
}

export interface SubtaskConversationOptions {
    readonly labels: MwSubtaskConversationLabels;
    readonly source: SubtaskConversationSource;
    onBack(parent: MwSubtaskLink | undefined): void;
    onClose(): void;
}

export type SubtaskConversationRead = {
    readonly state: "available";
    readonly view: MwSubtaskConversationView;
} | {
    readonly state: "denied";
    readonly reason: string;
};

export interface SubtaskConversationSource {
    read(target: string, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<SubtaskConversationRead>;
    subscribe?(target: string, invalidate: () => void, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<() => void>;
    composer(view: MwSubtaskConversationView): SubtaskComposerOptions;
    check(target: string, requestId: string, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<SubtaskActionOutcome>;
    act(view: MwSubtaskConversationView, action: MwSubtaskAction, requestId: string, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<SubtaskActionOutcome>;
}

export declare function createSubtaskConversation(root: HTMLElement, options: SubtaskConversationOptions): SubtaskConversationHandle;
